description: DiscoverCars.com is a car rental comparison and booking platform headquartered in Riga, Latvia, working with more than 1,000 rental suppliers. evidence.summary: Official affiliate page fetched in full: 'You earn a 70% commission from our car rental profit and a 30% commission on Full Coverage... Your commission is a percentage of our profit, not of the price the customer pays.' Page also states ~$20 average commission per booking, 365-day cookie lifetime, dedicated account manager, free sign-up in a few minutes, monthly payment via PayPal or wire transfer, and testimonial quotes from travel bloggers/content creators. Official Affiliate Program Terms: 70% commission on car rentals and 30% on Full Coverage, percentages taken from Discover Cars' profit, on completed bookings net of cancellations; cookie lifetime 365 days; payout invoiced once the amount exceeds $200. No 'no cap / unlimited earnings' statement was found, so cap is unknown.

description: SafetyWing sells travel medical and health insurance built for digital nomads, remote workers and long-term travelers, and is headquartered in San Francisco. Its Ambassador Program is its affiliate program: registered ambassadors earn a fee promoting SafetyWing products via a unique link, with promotion explicitly welcomed on social media, video and blogs.

evidence.summary: Official Ambassador page fetched: 'Become a SafetyWing Ambassador'; earnings estimator based on audience size; states 'Our Ambassadors include content creators like Chelsea Kauai and Nomadic Matt, and websites like Travel Off Path' and offers exclusive webinars, forums, events and workshops.

Official SafetyWing Help Center article fetched in full: 'Ambassadors are registered affiliates who earn a fee by promoting SafetyWing products... All you have to do is create an account and answer a few questions about yourself. It should only take you a few minutes.' Promotion allowed on 'any social media, personal website, video, or blogging platform'; payments made within the first ten working days of the new month.

Affiliate directory listings quote SafetyWing's own program wording: a flat affiliate fee 'currently benchmarked at approximately 10% of the total premium amount' on completed applications via the referral link, recurring on purchases/renewals within a 364-day window, $10 minimum payout. The 10% rate itself was not printed on the fetched safetywing.com pages, hence publicly_reported confidence for the rate.

description: Outdoorsy is a peer-to-peer RV rental marketplace headquartered in Austin, Texas, connecting RV owners with renters. Its affiliate program pays a flat bounty per referred renter's first confirmed booking and per RV owner who completes a listing, tracked over a 30-day attribution cookie via AvantLink, CJ or HasOffers (Tune).

evidence.summary: Official Affiliate Terms fetched in full: enrollment is by online application via the Outdoorsy Affiliate Program page; commission is paid when a referred renter's first booking is confirmed and when an RV owner completes listing; 30-day attribution cookie; automated payments via AvantLink, CJ or HasOffers once the affiliate reaches a $100 minimum balance. The terms do not state the dollar amount.

Official affiliate page: 'Through the Outdoorsy Affiliate Program, you can help us achieve this mission by referring RV owners and renters, while earning lucrative commissions for every referral!' and 'The Outdoorsy Affiliate Program is currently run on the HasOffers (Tune) and AvantLink Affiliate Networks.'

Flat bounty (not a percentage): multiple independent listings agree on a $60 base commission per completed booking or new RV listing — Travelpayouts ('$60 or more per booking or RV owner listing', 30-day cookie via AvantLink, also HasOffers/Tune), Admitad's program roundup ('$60+') and GetLasso ('$80 per successful booking and listing' — higher figure, treated as unverified). Because the published pay is a flat $60 per action, commission_rate is null.

description: Airalo is an eSIM marketplace founded in 2019 with its operational headquarters in Singapore, selling local, regional and global data plans for 200+ destinations. Its affiliate program, run through Impact, is explicitly positioned for creators, influencers and bloggers who earn commission on every eSIM bought through their links.

evidence.summary: Official Airalo Partners blog: 'Perfect for creators, influencers, and bloggers, the Affiliate Program allows you to earn commissions while sharing affordable travel solutions with your audience... Airalo affiliates gain access to Impact, a user-friendly platform that makes creating and tracking commission links easy' with pre-designed marketing materials and automatic tracking links.

Official Airalo Partners post: 'Whether you're a travel blogger, deal site, YouTuber, or social media influencer, you have the power to provide your followers with an affordable, hassle-free way to stay connected when they travel'; affiliates share a link and earn a commission for each successful referral, with sign-up via Airalo Partners. Listings quoting Airalo's own Impact program wording: 'Standard commission rate 10% on the final sale value (after discounts); rates may vary by promotional method' — one-time per sale, manual approval, worldwide, via Impact; paid monthly with a $15 minimum via bank/PayPal. The separate $3 Airmoney credit is a consumer refer-a-friend perk, not the affiliate program.
